hypothesis.statement: The frame is NOT induction-variable-count driven (PROBE A has the same three induction chains as the baseline and still drops to 40) and it is NOT declaration-count driven (three run-41 declaration probes were NEUTRAL-IDENTICAL). What the four probes DO establish is a clean exclusive trade with only two reachable states, both measured this pass: (i) COMMITTED, `dstOffset = row * 16; srcOffset = row * 4;` - scratch band byte-exact, frame 48, real 10, fuzzy 99.9685%, residual = 5 aligned IMMEDIATE frame words; (ii) PROBE C, dstOffset as an accumulator - frame 40/40 with SLOT MAP IDENTICAL, band rotated, real 34, insns 159/159, opcode multiset IDENTICAL, residual = a consistent register rotation plus ONE transposition of the two induction updates at 0x1e4/0x1ec. The rotation is quoted from PROBE C's aligned view at each DEFINITION SITE - the row counter is target `@0x178 li r9,0` against ours `@0x178 li r8,0`; the dstOffset seed is target `@0x17c li r3,0` against ours `@0x184 li r9,0`; the srcOffset seed is target `@0x184 li r4,0` against ours `@0x17c li r3,0`; the matrix cursor is target `@0x1ac add r7,r30,r4` against ours `@0x1ac add r6,r30,r3`; the view3 cursor is target `@0x1b0 add r8,r31,r3` against ours `@0x1b0 add r7,r31,r9`; and the two inner-loop counters are target `@0x1b4 li r5,0` / `@0x1b8 li r6,0` against ours `@0x1b4 li r4,0` / `@0x1b8 li r5,0`. The two transposed induction updates are target `@0x1e4 addi r4,r4,4` and `@0x1ec addi r3,r3,16` against ours `@0x1e4 addi r9,r9,16` and `@0x1ec addi r3,r3,4`. The two states are not comparable on fuzzy alone, because they are in different POSTPROCESSOR CLASSES: state (i)'s five frame-size immediates are stack-layout words that no shipped class can touch, so state (i) can never be finished by a rule; state (ii) is a permutation-plus-consistent-recolor at equal counts, which is exactly what instruction_permutation + copy_register_fields/verify_consistent_recolor model. The next lane's step 1 is therefore NOT another offset respell - it is the CLASS decision, and it belongs to the integrator: keeping (i) costs 0.80 fuzzy less than nothing but forecloses the function permanently, while moving to (ii) costs 0.80 fuzzy and 24 real and opens an EQUIVALENT close. If the decision is to stay at (i), the one untried SOURCE axis left is MWCC's outgoing-parameter area: target 40 = 8 linkage + 8 param area + 24 saves (r26-r31) while ours is 8 + 16 + 24, and both calls in the function (pbInitCamera, CopyMat3) take exactly 2 pointer arguments, so a 16-byte outgoing area is unexplained by the call sites and worth one census of what else in this TU reserves 16.
